item.text: The parser currently handles interpolation and `email.local`; it has no matcher types. The utility package already provides `GlobToRegexp`, so I’ll use that for anchored wildcard patterns and parse the template function calls separately.

item.text: The implementation compiles, and the new tests caught two expectation mistakes: `regexp.match("bar")` uses normal regexp search behavior, and Go formats the invalid regexp error with backticks. I’m correcting those assertions and adding coverage for malformed expressions and argument validation.

item.text: The matcher tests now cover literals, globs, raw regexps, both `regexp` functions, prefixes and suffixes, and the required error cases. I’ve also made an expression with no surrounding text return its matcher directly. I’ll run the package tests and final checks now.

Implemented matcher support in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go), including literals, anchored wildcards, raw regexps, `regexp.match`, `regexp.not_match`, and static prefixes and suffixes. `Variable()` now rejects matcher functions. Added coverage in [parse_test.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go).

Verification passed: `GOPROXY=off go test ./lib/utils/parse` and `git diff --check`.
